_comment: OBS-01..18 transcribed (neutral English) from docs/diagnosis/observables/OBS-*.md: definition, frame, best camera, layer. Values are closed answer sets; a value whose text starts with a:/b:/c: belongs to sub-item (a)/(b)/(c) of that observable. 'reliability' is deliberately 'untested' here (the 10/17 per-model agreement counts live in the OBS md files and are not re-measured). No FTT/book/fault references in this file.

observables.question: At the contact frame, is the hitting elbow clearly bent (roughly 90-120 degrees) or nearly straight?
At the contact frame, how far is the hitting hand/wrist from the side of the torso: upper arm touching the ribs, or a visible gap?
At the contact frame, where is the ball (or string center) relative to the front hip, front to back?
At the top of the backswing, does the racket stop for a noticeable moment (about 0.3 s or more) before the forward swing starts?
Between the ball leaving the machine/opponent and contact, does the player show a split step and small adjusting steps with the feet?
At the start of the forward swing (after the feet are set), how are the feet oriented relative to the incoming ball direction?

Non-hitting arm: (a) when the shoulder turn is completed, does it reach across the front of the body; (b) does it leave the racket before or after the turn is completed; (c) at the start of the forward swing, has it already dropped to the side or does it rotate with the chest?
At the end of the preparation turn (before the hand starts to drop under the ball), how far are the shoulder line and hip line rotated away from the target?
At the contact frame, have the hips rotated back to roughly face the target?
Back foot: (a) is the heel off the ground at contact; (b) within 0.5 s after contact does the foot swing around to the front, kick backward, or stay in place?
Between the start of the forward swing and contact, what path does the hitting hand take?
At the contact frame: (a) is the forearm roughly horizontal, tilted up or tilted down; (b) is the racket shaft near horizontal, tilted, or near vertical?
(a) At the contact frame, is the body weight mainly on the front foot, the back foot or between them; (b) within 0.5 s after contact does the body keep moving toward the net, or go backward/upward?
Forward lean of the trunk (hip center to shoulder center versus vertical): how does it change from the moment the preparation is complete to the contact frame?

Follow-through: (a) where does the racket finish relative to the non-hitting shoulder; (b) after contact does the hand extend toward the target for a stretch or wrap back to the body immediately; (c) at the end, is the hitting elbow in front of the chest?
Result of each shot (spoken by the player or visible from where the ball lands / how it is struck).
At the deepest point of the backswing (just before the forward swing starts), where does the racket head point?
At the start of the forward swing, which part starts moving toward the target first?
